releases.name: City Seek 2026-11-13
releases.body: Added Music mode, chosen from the Mode switch in the menu. The city plays as a beat synced music visualizer: load a song or use the built in test beat, and the scene moves in time with the kicks, bass and hats. Views include a top down flyover where beat objects land on matching ground and cars follow streets, a train window view, a Lanes view that works like a street styled MIDI waterfall, and a Rain view with a color jar catching game. Added an action line with hit bursts for each band, an infographic layer, isometric train buildings with cutaways, and richer street detail. A hunt while it plays option, a stream hunt, and REC video recording with sound are included.

jobs.description: A zoomable generated city where you hunt for hidden items, with towers, birds, and sound.

releases.name: Artifactium 2026-11-13
releases.body: Created Artifactium, a found object archive with a flowchart tree explorer. The app was synced to a new backend that keeps records in a database and can store photos. Contributors can now sign in with an email code and pick a handle, and the backend checks who is signed in.

jobs.description: A found object archive with a flowchart tree explorer and contributor sign in.

releases.name: Delivery Twin 2026-11-13
releases.body: Added fog of war spots, then pickups, dropoffs, and delivery lines on the map. Lockers are now hidden, the color key folds away, and there is a link to Field Dispatch. Delivery Twin now has its own inventory app, and an Offers tab replaces Roads.

jobs.description: A phone friendly field log with a map, receipts, and mileage, now with a food spots layer.

releases.name: raineurysm 2026-11-13
releases.body: Created raineurysm, a rain music toy where rain falls into vessels that play notes. Rain lanes, drums, bass, a storm zone, narrow cups, and tilt and pour were added. It joins the Stompbox Lab band room, with lanes that rain on the band beat, a shared scale, and notes sent out to visualizers. Vessels come in several kinds, including cup, jug, metal pan, plate, singing bowl, wood block, and ladle, and lanes can rain in triplets, quads, and call and response. Touch handling was tightened so cups land under the finger and a slim vessel panel opens on a tap.

jobs.description: A rain music toy where falling rain hits vessels that play notes.
